model_info.name: 博理館
model_info.scope: 七層主體外觀，依2004落成承包商與2010校方照片；已見前立面/左短端保留，未知背面及右短端簡化

layer_check.method: Horizontal triangle-plane intersections, 0.2 mm pitch, first z=0.071 mm; welded endpoints rounded to 1e-6 mm
limitations: Closed contours do not establish extrusion continuity, adhesion, toolpaths, bridging, or support accessibility.
Tiny cross-sections near curved or pointed roofs are expected; minimum loop bbox is not a wall-thickness measurement.
Unseen elevations are simplified. Support settings must be reviewed in a real print slicer.

thin_check.method: Actual STL XY sections with canonical edge interpolation and closed-loop assertions at 1.0mm pitch, z offset .071mm; morphological opening radius 0.4mm. Narrow tips and sharp corners also contribute.
thin_check.judgment: Review fine roof/rim/corner regions and use supports where needed; no automatic printability claim.
